decision: Resolve C01-SG003 prospectively: C01 owns only canonical-contract conformance; C02 regenerates language and UI models; C03 exclusively owns the five authorized handwritten runtime and regression-test migration paths; C04 owns the repository-wide zero-failure conformance gate; B04 begins only after C04 PASS. PromotionDecision grants a non-null canonical level only for PROMOTE or CONDITIONAL, while REJECT, UNDERDETERMINED, and BLOCKED require granted_level null and preserve prior candidate state. Authorize C01-0004 without changing C01-0003 or any earlier history.
rationale: C01-0003 correctly established that the canonical schemas, examples, OpenAPI document, and targeted contract tests conform while exactly 24 full-suite failures remain in handwritten runtime producers and their tests. Assigning that migration to C03, generated parity to C02, and the final full-suite gate to C04 preserves package boundaries without weakening resolved_refs, reintroducing legacy enum aliases, hiding failures, or allowing incoherent packaging. Non-granting decisions represent no newly granted level and therefore use null rather than copying an existing Passport level.
